main.description: A titled discussion thread, such as a forum thread or a chat channel. Written by its author. Forked from site.standard.document: same field names, plus parent for nesting. Replies are community.lexicon.thread.post records that point at it.

group.description: The group the thread belongs to: a community.lexicon.thread.group (at://), or the group's URL (https://) for a loose thread.

path.description: Combine with the publication url to build the thread's canonical URL. Starts with a slash.

parent.description: The thread this one lives in, such as the channel a forum thread was posted to. Absent for a top-level thread, which a forum can feature as a channel with community.lexicon.thread.channel.

document.description: A site.standard.document that is the same piece of writing, such as a blog post opened up for discussion on a forum. Only counts when the document is in the same repo and links back with community.lexicon.thread.defs#link.

description.description: A short summary written by the author. When it's absent, clients show the start of textContent instead: up to 300 characters and at most 3 paragraphs.

textContent.description: Plain-text rendering of the opening post. Should not contain markdown or other formatting.

content.description: The opening post in an app-native format. Open union, as in site.standard.document.

updatedAt.description: When the author last edited the title or opening post. Not the time of the latest reply, which indexers derive from posts.
